messages:
anna: Quick sync: AcmeCloud flagged the legacy compatibility shim as a performance and packaging headache. They
sked for a clear deprecation path and marketplace labeling so their QA can switch to shimless bundles.

leo-partner: Confirmed. Their packager sees duplicated header escapes when shim is present. Perf hit ~50ms p95 and adds noise to tests. Theyan migrate but need a timetable.

devon: Suggestion: telemetry -> opt-in flag -> public advisory -> grace period -> removal. Keep Dedicated/private installs on a separate path.

maria: I'll instrument registry and adapter images. Plan: emit `partner_shim_usage{partner}` and a weekly rollup. Need 72 hours to ship and one canary.

anna: Tentative schedule: telemetry (3d), feature-flag for new installs (1w), announce 30d grace, removal window after 60d. Anyone object?

samir: Dedicated customers: they may not pull registry updates. We need a manual upgrade playbook (runbook + sed/patch examples) and a way for SIs to request extended grace.

leo-partner: Marketplace metadata request: add `shim_removed` boolean, `migration_notes` URL, and a visible deprecation badge in Console listing. That helps our vendor ops.

devon: Console banner ticket created. We can show per-listing banners and an auto-badge if `shim_removed == true` and `extended_grace == false`.

maria: Telemetry details: expose partner-level metric and emit events to partner-telemetry topic. Will include an `extended_grace` label so we can exclude partners with negotiated windows.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed telemetry agent on infra-canary-3 (build 5481).

anna: Communication checklist: partner pre-brief (private), public marketplace advisory, docs migration guide + code snippets, sample packaging PR for partners, sunset date + rollback plan. Owners?

leo-partner: I'll handle the partner pre-brief and provide partner-specific test packages and examples.

maria: Docs + code samples 10: will include curl and Python examples showing header changes and a small diff for packaging.

samir: I'll draft the Dedicated runbook: manual patch steps, quick rollback commands, and a checklist for SI maintenance windows. Include an emergency hotfix branch.

devon: Engineering gating rule: allow removal only when global active shim usage < 3% across marketplace installs OR after explicit signoff from partners with >5% usage. We'll automate the check in the deployment pipeline.

anna: Agreement: go forward with proposed timeline. Add exception workflow: partners can request extended grace via partner-ops form; mark them with `extended_grace` so auto-removal ignores them.

leo-partner: Two large SIs already asked for longer windows due to scheduled maintenance quarters. We'll offer extended grace on request and display a note in listing.

maria: I'll add an `extended_grace` boolean in telemetry and a partner-visible dashboard slice so they can see their own counts.

samir: Risk register items: 1) Dedicated upgrades fail -> mitigation: prebuilt rollback artifacts + SI tabletop; 2) Marketplace bundles that embedded shim logic -> mitigation: pre-scan during listing update + sample PR.

anna: Action items and owners: maria: telemetry rollout (72h). devon: feature-flag + Console banner (1w). samir: Dedicated runbook + SI tabletop (coord). leo-partner: partner pre-brief + test packages. I'll draft the public advisory and partner email by EOD Friday.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Please record change on the change calendar for 2024-02-10.

leo-partner: I'll loop in legal for the partner email wording and schedule a tabletop with two SI reps next Tue.

maria: Docs PR incoming; will link here when ready.

anna: If anyone sees blockers, post them here. Otherwise proceed on telemetry cadence. :thumbsup:
